value.given: A poll holds two ballots and the host has moved it to closed status, while the shared device still shows the member voting surface.
value.negative: Neither a first ballot under a new code nor a replacement under an existing code may be stored while the poll is closed, and the aggregate must not shift by even one count.
value.then: Both writes are rejected with response poll_closed, no ballot row is added or changed, and the tally still reports the two original ballots with unchanged per-option counts.
value.when: A member submits a first ballot under a new code, and a different member re-submits with an existing code to change their choice.

value.given: An existing poll is open on the shared device and a member is at the start view.
value.negative: A poll created by a member, without any host declaration, would hand setup ownership to the wrong role and break the fixed option-set guarantee.
value.then: The attempt is refused as not_host, the setup form is not offered to the member, no poll or option row is stored, and the existing poll stays unchanged.
value.when: The member attempts to create a second poll through the host-only setup entry.

value.given: An open poll has one ballot for code ana on option A and the tally has just been displayed.
value.negative: If ballots lived only in memory, or if startup replayed a stored write, the count would drop to zero or double instead of staying at one.
value.then: The ballot is re-read with the same code and option, the per-option counts and total are identical, and no ballot is duplicated or replayed.
value.when: The surface is refreshed and the process is stopped and started again in the same application directory.
